sources: Ancient Canal (WeaponBasicTable wpn_claym_0014): its Strength and Arts Intensity lines and sk_wpn_claym_0014's Arts Intensity +phy_spell_up (cardAttributeModifier attr 87) are on the stat panel. sk_wpn_claym_0014 passiveEventActions: abilityEvent 208 (the wielder consumes a buff) + CheckBuffIdInContext tag 1075718177 (Vulnerable) + CheckConsumeBuffLayer → count; SimpleCalcBB phy_dmg_up = phy_dmg_up_mult × count → CreateBuff buff_wpn_claym_0014_pdi_up (attr 50 Physical DMG, `duration` 20 s). Description: "After the wielder consumes Vulnerability stack(s), the wielder gains Physical DMG Dealt +[{phy_dmg_up_mult} × Stacks Consumed] for {duration}s. Effects of the same name cannot stack." Values: SkillPatchTable sk_wpn_claym_0014 (phy_dmg_up_mult 0.14 at level 9). Batch-3 report docs/kit-batches/batch-3/chr_0018_dapan.md rows E1–E4.

buff_wpn_claym_0014_pdi_up is stackingType 1 with priority key phy_dmg_up_mult and maxStackCnt 2: the loader keeps up to two instances, each with its own timer, and only the strongest acts (batch 3 B1); at the limit the weakest goes, so a weaker reapplication over two stronger ones isn't applied.

toggleBuffs buff_wpn_passive_spirit_01 (atk_up, a key sk_wpn_claym_0014 doesn't have): a template leftover with no effect, as Twilight's (batch 1). buff_wpn_claym_0014 (attr 87 phy_spell_up, lifeType 1) is referenced by no file: the panel's Arts Intensity line stands for it.

buffs.label: Brutality: Lands of Yore (Physical DMG)
buffs.note: Its value is taken at the event (the stacks consumed): 0.56 after a 4-stack Crush at level 9.

triggers.note: Crush and Breach are what consume Vulnerable (status.ts); the event's level is the stacks consumed. beforeDamage: the status buff's FinishBuff of Vulnerable (abilityEvent 208) runs before its DamageAction (buff_physical_do_crushed), so the Crush and the hit applying it carry the bonus (in-game test 51, Da Pan part).
